rows.note: Use this specifically for the nucleus of a biological cell.

example.traditional: 細胞核入面有遺傳物質。
example.jyutping: sai3 baau1 hat6 jap6 min6 jau5 wai4 cyun4 mat6 zat1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the positively charged central part of an atom.

example.english: The nucleus carries a positive charge.
example.jyutping: jyun4 zi2 hat6 daai3 zyu6 zing3 din6 ho4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a central core or the initial core of a larger project or collection.

example.english: We’ll build this nucleus first, then slowly add features.
example.traditional: 我哋先整好呢個核心，之後再慢慢加功能。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sin1 zing2 hou2 ni1 go3 hat6 sam1 zi1 hau6 zoi3 maan6 maan6 gaa1 gung1 nang4

rows.note: Use this for the literal central part or point of something, rather than its organizing core.

example.english: The circle’s nucleus has a black dot.
example.jyutping: go3 jyun4 hyun1 zung1 sam1 jau5 nap1 hak1 dim2
